title: Rav Chama son of Rabbah bar Avuha
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman treats him as a colleague of Abaye, as in [Eruvin 3a](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.3a.6), where Abaye raised a difficulty against Rav Yosef: “But Chama son of Rabbah bar Avuha teaches it.” In [Bava Metzia 105b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Metzia.105b.10) a certain elder said to him, “I will explain it to you.”

Hyman infers that he went to the Land of Israel and afterward returned to Babylonia, as in [Ketubot 85a](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.85a.4-5): Avimi son of Rabbi Abbahu — the people of Bei Chozai had a claim of money against him (that is, they were his creditors); he sent it through Chama son of Rava bar Abbahu. He went and paid them; he said to them, “Give me the document.” They said to him, “These are for another debt.” (Avimi — so it is in the Rif) came before Rabbi Abbahu, etc.[^1]

notes.text: Avimi owes the money and sends Chama with payment. The creditors say they applied it to another debt. The consulted Ketubot gives Rabbah bar Abbahu, beside the heading’s Rabbah bar Avuha and the supplied body’s Rava bar Abbahu. The journey and the Rif variant are Hyman’s reports.
